title: CVC claims accounting manipulation in €3bn Advent pastry ingredients deal
summary: CVC alleges Advent manipulated accounts at Italian pastry-ingredients maker Irca before the €3bn sale. Advent denies that Irca's financial performance was overstated.

title: The AI cyber threat is already here
summary: The FT warns that AI-enabled cyber threats are already a reality, not a future risk. It frames current incidents as only the start of a broader wave.

title: La caída del peso… ¿sin efecto inflacionario?
summary: El peso se depreció casi 4% entre el 18 y el 20 de noviembre y llegó a 19.16 por dólar, nivel no visto desde junio de 2025. El análisis evalúa si la magnitud del movimiento podría traducirse en traspaso a precios al consumidor.

title: FBI investiga un nuevo ataque informático contra Centro Nacional de Información Criminal: CNN
summary: El FBI investiga una aparente intrusión informática en su Centro Nacional de Información Criminal (NCIC), según CNN. Es el segundo incidente de seguridad de este tipo que afecta a la agencia en los últimos meses.

title: ¿Tu manera de dirigir funciona en cualquier situación?
summary: Basado en Harvard Business Review, el texto propone desarrollar una 'inteligencia del estrés' para adaptar el estilo de liderazgo a cada situación. Las cualidades que llevaron a alguien a dirigir pueden no bastar cuando cambian las circunstancias.

title: Las claves económicas de la semana (16 al 20 de noviembre): De minutas de la Fed y Banxico
summary: Resumen de la semana económica: datos de manufactura, previsiones de actividad y consumo en México. También se publicaron las minutas de las decisiones de política monetaria de Banxico y la Fed.

title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
summary: Following Anthropic's record IPO, a researcher at the company says he used Claude to solve a famous number-theory problem that has stumped mathematicians for over 150 years. The claim highlights frontier models' growing role in advanced research.

title: El peso mexicano pierde 3,5% en la semana y toca los MXN$19,19, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025
summary: El peso cerró la semana con una pérdida de 3.5% y tocó 19.19 por dólar, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025. La presión vino de las expectativas sobre las tasas de Banxico y la Fed.

title: Hindlian Advisory CEO on AI & Anthropic Market Sell-off
summary: Former NYSE capital-markets head Amanda Hindlian says Anthropic's IPO should be judged apart from the week's market volatility. The deal priced well with a book estimated at five to seven times oversubscribed and traded strongly on debut.

title: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith on AI Usage in the Workplace
summary: Scribe CEO Jennifer Smith cites research putting AI use for workplace tasks below 4%. She contrasts that with the heavy chatbot use seen in tech circles, pointing to a large adoption gap.

title: Adjusting for Credit Risk: Masters In Business with David Eichhorn
summary: NISA CEO David Eichhorn discusses the risks and benefits of private credit on Masters in Business. He warns about the dangers of private credit flowing into pension funds and 401(k)s.

title: Nvidia faces US regulator’s probe into its accounting
summary: The SEC has opened an investigation into Nvidia's accounting. The probe adds to the chipmaker's difficulties following Jensen Huang's resignation.

title: US tech stocks plunge into bear market in worst week since Covid-19 crisis
summary: US tech stocks fell into a bear market in their worst week since the Covid-19 crisis. Anthropic and Nvidia shares tumbled as fears over the AI spending boom gripped Wall Street.

title: México oficializa control a inversiones extranjeras y abre incertidumbre por adquisiciones
summary: México oficializó un mecanismo de control sobre inversiones extranjeras, lo que abre incertidumbre para futuras adquisiciones. La medida podría afectar la estructuración y aprobación de operaciones de M&A en el país.

title: JPMorgan Gets Lowballed Below 80 Cents for Qualtrics Hung Debt
summary: JPMorgan is fielding offers below 80 cents on the dollar as it weighs selling hung debt tied to a Qualtrics acquisition. The lowball bids reflect tightening appetite for risky buyout financing.

title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
summary: AI coding startup Cognition is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months after its last round. The talks signal continued investor appetite for agentic coding tools despite the market selloff.

title: Donald Trump threatens ‘tremendous’ tax on data centres built outside US
summary: President Trump threatened a 'tremendous' tax on data centres built outside the US. He framed it as a fight to keep Beijing from taking the lead in AI development.

title: Odd Lots: Minerva Co-Founder on the Risks of “Abliterated” Models
summary: On Odd Lots, Minerva co-founder Daniel Saedi explains how his firm mixes and matches AI models for specific use cases. He also discusses the risks posed by 'abliterated' models whose safety guardrails have been removed.

title: Altruist’s Wenk on AI and the Next Era of Financial Advice
summary: Altruist CEO Jason Wenk discusses what joining Vanguard could mean for the firm and how AI could reshape the economics of wealth management. He also covers the RIA custody market and plans to broaden Altruist's product offering.

title: US Credit-Fear Hits 8-Month High as Tech Angst Roils Markets
summary: Measures of perceived US credit risk hit an eight-month high and the cost of insuring big tech firms' debt jumped. The wobbling AI trade drove volatility and sent investors into safe havens.

title: Competencia en redes de pagos con tarjeta dependerá de regulación: Mastercard
summary: Mastercard afirma que la regulación de las redes de pago con tarjeta en México será clave para que los participantes compitan en igualdad de condiciones. Su cámara de compensación en el país sigue de cerca los proyectos de las autoridades financieras.

title: Comienzan las ofertas para comprar Axtel y su controladora
summary: Arrancó el proceso de ofertas para adquirir Axtel y su empresa controladora. Es una de las transacciones corporativas relevantes en México en curso.

title: Hotel Tepoztlán / Taller Carlos Marín + Pasquinel Studio
summary: Hotel Tepoztlán, by Taller Carlos Marín and Pasquinel Studio, sits between Tepoztlán and Amatlán in Morelos. Its master plan of four buildings integrates topography, landscape and views of the Tepozteco on a formerly abandoned plot.

title: Anthropic Slides 8.5% to Shrink IPO Gain as AI Trade Unravels
summary: Anthropic shares fell 8.5% on Friday, erasing part of their first-day jump after the AI lab completed the biggest IPO in history. The pullback tests public investors' faith as the broader AI trade unravels.

title: Wall Street Reels as AI Fears Erupt; Nasdaq 100 Near Bear Market
summary: Concerns about the AI trade turned into a market-wide selloff on Friday. Anthropic slumped after its debut while Nvidia sank 14%, pushing the Nasdaq 100 to the brink of a bear market.

title: Hotel Casa Zamná Tulum / Studio Arquitectos
summary: Casa Zamná is a boutique hotel by StudioArqs on a 5,160 m² beachfront plot in Tulum. It blends contemporary design with traditional regional elements facing the Caribbean.

title: Mexican Studio COLECTIVO C733 Named First Recipient of the Siza Award for Public Architecture
summary: Mexico-based COLECTIVO C733 was named the first recipient of the Serralves Foundation's Siza Award for public architecture. The award recognizes architectural generosity and engagement with public space.

title: Emerging Stocks Enter Bear Market as AI Triggers Global Selloff
summary: The MSCI emerging-market stock index entered a bear market after seven straight declines, its longest losing streak since 2024. The global tech selloff drove the slide.

title: Anthropic soars, but it may soon be back, cap in hand
summary: The Economist argues Anthropic's record-breaking IPO is only a beginning. The company may soon need to return to markets for more capital.

title: Jensen Huang’s fall is bad news for Silicon Valley’s accelerationists
summary: The Economist says Jensen Huang's fall is a blow to Silicon Valley's AI accelerationists. The movement was already on the back foot.
